title: Workspace naming
scope: These rules apply only when you explicitly choose backend workspace creation. Existing workspace choices keep their current names.
help_base_directory: Use {home} for the selected computer’s home folder, or an absolute path.
help_branch_template: Also supports {repo}, {base-branch} and {branch}. Branch fields need an explicit starting branch.
root: One repository at the task root
failed: Couldn’t load naming settings. Your current workspace is unchanged.
save_failed: Couldn’t confirm the save. Your draft is kept. Reload the saved settings before retrying.
preview_failed: Couldn’t preview names on this computer. Check its connection and version, then retry.
unsupported: Update the server to configure backend workspace naming.
field_empty: Enter a valid value for {field}, or leave it blank to use the default.
field_not_allowed: A template field is unavailable in {field}.
field_unavailable: A value needed by {field} is missing. Choose an explicit starting branch or change the template.
path_invalid: The folder template contains an unsafe path. Use relative folder names without . or .. segments.
base_scope_denied: Choose a base folder outside Persona’s private data and credential folders.
branch_invalid: The generated branch name is invalid. Change the branch template.
git_validation_unavailable: The computer couldn’t validate the branch name. Check that Git is available.
context_invalid: The selected computer couldn’t report its home folder.
layout_invalid: A repository at the root requires exactly one selected repository.
alias_invalid: Choose a valid repository folder name.
alias_duplicate: Selected repositories have the same folder name. Set distinct folder aliases.
repository_invalid: Check the selected repository and starting ref.
invalid_task_id: Save the task before previewing its folder.
timezone_defaulted: No assistant time zone is saved; this preview uses UTC.
collision_risk: This folder template has no task ID. Preparation will check for a name conflict.
path_too_long: The generated path is too long. Shorten the folder template.
fragment_normalized: The starting branch is normalized to one folder-safe fragment in the generated name.
node_unavailable: The selected computer is offline or does not support naming previews. Check its connection and version.
check_fields: Check the highlighted fields and retry. Your draft is kept.
